title: In Search of Ouologuem
text:
Title: In Search of Ouologuem

Unique works of literature trigger deep amazement, and some suspicion: is this the work of a single mind? This must have been especially so in the case of a young black man who exhibited arrogance and confidence on every page. Ouologuem was not yet thirty when he authored his remarkable novel. No doubt, some felt that something did not add up and that there were things concealed from critics and readers pertaining to his work—a secret, a scandal.
